note: All claims PROPOSED. No model has run. No empirical evidence exists. Claim 4 split into 4a-4d; claim 3 corrected (proportional model is zero-intercept linear).

claims.text: The software correctly implements a local regularized right-inverse on synthetic matrices under declared rank conditions; damped operators are labeled LOCAL_DAMPED_REALIZER, not exact projectors.

A CAS probe reads a CAS coordinate that generalizes to a held-out split and beats surface, metadata, shuffled-label, matched-non-CAS, and random-same-rank controls (AUROC>=0.75, margin>=0.10, bootstrap CI excludes zero).

A computed intervention moves the requested CAS coordinate AND improves exact agent/patient role accuracy (>=10pp over zero/random), beating random and ordinary matched-norm directions, with <=2pp collateral damage.

The profile-specific proportional model y_hat=a/r_eff predicts a disjoint held-out split (nRMSE<=0.20), beats zero-response and mean-response, carries calibrated uncertainty, and is not more than 5% worse in held-out MAE than the preregistered affine/quadratic alternatives. NOT tested against zero-intercept linear regression (algebraically identical).
The whole method reaches >=0.90 exact accuracy with >=25% fewer median examples than ordinary LoRA.
The whole method reaches threshold with >=20% fewer median optimizer steps than ordinary LoRA.
CAS-guided consolidation loses >=5pp less prior-skill accuracy at matched new-task accuracy versus baselines.
The whole method reduces total elapsed time by >=10% AFTER all controller and measurement overhead is included.
